text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: it ran 16 tests and all of them passed. I only changed code in `catalog/`, not the tests. These are the fixes:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the tests and the comment above it say five. I set it to 5.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days instead of multiplying. It now multiplies.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing a third book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The docstring and tests only fix the title, so the author, year and copy count are my choice.
